item.title: Helium v3.2.5
item.description:
Helium 3.2.5 | TrollStore
Massive merge of features from [AsakuraFuuko's repo](https://github.com/AsakuraFuuko/Helium)
**Top features from v3.0.0-v3.2.5 include:** - Landscape mode now works properly! - Massive improvements to the adaptive color functionality - Choosing the text font - Option for italic text - Update interval can be controlled for each widget - New weather widget (must set your own API key) - Enabling and disabling widget sets - HUD now updates widget sets without having to restart the HUD - Option for a debug border around the widgets - Date locale fixes for Chinese users - Chinese translation - A whole lot of other improvements/fixes
Once again, thank you so much to AsakuraFuuko for this huge update. I would like to welcome them to the development team, where they will hopefully continue to update the app! Keep an eye out for this up-and-coming dev 👀
